items.title: Pay overdue electricity balance
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Gesamtbetrag bis zum 23. April 2025.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis zum 23. April 2025.' This is the stated due date as written for the total outstanding amount of EUR 198.50 (EUR 196.00 arrears + EUR 2.50 dunning fee); no period calculation is needed since the date is explicit. A bank transfer should be sent about one business day earlier to arrive in time (§ 675s BGB).

items.title: Earliest possible date supply could be interrupted
items.quote: Geht bis dahin keine Zahlung ein, sind wir nach § 19 StromGVV berechtigt, die Versorgung frühestens vier Wochen nach dieser Androhung durch den Netzbetreiber unterbrechen zu lassen; den genauen Termin kündigen wir Ihnen acht Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: The 'Androhung' (threat of interruption) is this letter, dated 16.04.2025. Counting the four-week minimum notice period required by § 19 StromGVV: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (16.04.2025) is not counted, so the period starts 17.04.2025; four weeks (28 days) later, by § 188 Abs. 1 BGB, falls on 14.05.2025 (a Wednesday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). The letter states this is only the earliest ('frühestens') possible date — the actual interruption date is not fixed here and will be separately announced at least eight Werktage (working days, Mon–Sat) in advance, so it could be later than 14.05.2025 if payment remains outstanding.
